description: Tracks what the audience believes at each point in the season. Organized by misdirection track and episode phase. See bible/07_craft_feeling.md for misdirection architecture.

tracks.name: example_track
tracks.description: What the audience believes about [X] at each point in the story

phases.audience_belief: What the audience believes in this phase (early season)
phases.guidance: How the writer should manage this belief — reinforce the assumption

phases.audience_belief: What the audience believes at mid-season (assumption tested)
phases.guidance: Introduce details that don't quite fit — the audience should feel uneasy

phases.audience_belief: What the audience believes in the crisis phase (assumption cracking)
phases.guidance: The misdirection is half-broken — some viewers see the truth, others cling to the assumption

phases.audience_belief: What the audience believes after the finale (truth or productive ambiguity)
phases.guidance: Reveal or refuse to reveal — both are valid if the emotional arc is complete
